chapters.label: The corner, live
chapters.text: Pasadena, 1999. The World Cup final, USA against China. Extra time, and no goals. China take a corner... a header! Cleared off the line by Kristine Lilly!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Lilly guards the post. As the corner comes in, she steps across to make the goal smaller.

chapters.label: Eyes on the ball
chapters.text: Fan Yunjie’s header flies past the keeper. Eyes on the ball, Lilly heads it clear! Later, Brandi Chastain’s penalty won the Cup.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: At corners, guard the post. Stay alert and keep your eyes on the ball: one header can save the game!
